_note: Exact values read from each template's example.html (open-design commit 0701042f, 2026-11-16). pt = px / 2 on a 1920x1080 slide (13.33x7.5in). Fluid templates size in CSS px against a 1920x1080 window. Policy: every size is kept as shipped. The flags are information for the user and for porting, not instructions to resize.

themes.name: Tech Sharing
themes.author: lewislulu (html-ppt-skill, MIT); amber restyle by OpenDesign (Apache-2.0)
themes.stance: Amber-phosphor terminal deck: warm off-black, one CRT-amber accent, IBM Plex Mono structure, hairline panels, sharp corners, no gradients or shadows.
themes.canvas: Fluid: each slide is 100vw x 100vh, padding 72px 96px; static preview (slides stacked, no runtime). Upstream runtime adds keyboard nav, S presenter popup, N notes, O overview.
colors: CRT amber: kickers, highlights, one tick per slide
devices: Terminal gutter: 1px vertical hairline at left:56px with a 9px amber tick at top:72px on every slide
Mono kicker with '> ' prefix above each title (e.g. 'agenda.toml', '// why-now')
Hairline cards, radius 0, no shadow; one 'hot' card per row with amber top border and 5% amber fill
Terminal window: 9px dots (first one amber), file name in the bar, warm syntax (kw amber, str sand, cmt dim italic)
Agenda rows: mono number, Sora title, mono duration on the right, hairline rules
One deliberate inversion: closing slide on paper with a large '>_' glyph
themes.motion: kf-rise: opacity 0 + translateY(24px) to rest, 0.6-0.7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); kicker, then title (+0.06s), then body (+0.14s). Reduced motion: none.
themes.research_fit: Good for systems / robotics-software talks and code walkthroughs. Gaps: no figure or plot layout, no maths, dark background for papers' white figures. Body text is web-sized (see flags).
flags: Card body 15.5px, terminal 15px, kicker 13px, tags and footer 12-12.5px, and lede 21px (10.5pt) are small for large rooms.
Dark background: paper figures with white backgrounds need re-export with transparent backgrounds.

themes.name: Product Launch
themes.author: lewislulu (html-ppt-skill, MIT); editorial restyle by OpenDesign (Apache-2.0)
themes.stance: Warm editorial launch keynote: one burnt-orange accent, warm off-white paper, warm off-black ink, Fraunces variable serif with optical sizing, hairline ledgers.
themes.canvas: Fluid: 100vw x 100vh slides, padding 88px 104px; headline sizes use clamp() against viewport width; static preview.
colors: primary text; background of the one inverted slide
burnt orange: kicker, rule, italic emphasis, proposed column
devices: Cover anchored to the bottom: mono kicker, 72x3px accent rule, three-line serif headline whose last line is italic accent
Centred nameplate slide framed by two strong hairlines
Hairline column grids (3-up / 2-up) with a glyph or serif stat on top of each column
Ledger rows with italic serif step numerals in accent
Pricing ledger: three columns, proposed column gets a 3px accent top bar
One inverted ink slide for the close: italic pull quote + huge accent number + button
Mono footer baseline: audience on the left, 'n / total' on the right
themes.motion: rise: translateY(24px) + fade, 0.7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), children staggered 0.06s.
themes.research_fit: Best match for job talks, invited talks and openings where the narrative matters. Gaps: no figure, video or maths layout; body text web-sized.
flags: Body 15.5px, kicker 12px, footer 11.5px and lede 20px are small for large rooms.
Headline sizes use clamp() on viewport width, so they shrink in small windows; when porting to a fixed canvas, use the 1920px value (the clamp maximum).

themes.name: Cyber Terminal (hermes)
themes.author: lewislulu (html-ppt-skill, MIT); repointed tokens by OpenDesign (Apache-2.0)
themes.stance: Dark terminal with neon mint/cyan, scanlines, masked grid and vignette; everything reads like a live shell session.
themes.canvas: Fluid: 100vw x 100vh slides, padding 60px 84px; static preview; upstream runtime has presenter view and notes.

fonts.role: display, headings, labels, code (the deck's voice)

colors: mint: prompt, h1, values, primary accent
devices: Window chrome row: three traffic-light dots + shell path ('~/session · zsh · 118x42')
'$ command' prompt line above every title; blinking block cursor after the cover title
Background stack: 56px grid with radial mask, 4px scanlines (screen blend), vignette
HUD cards: 2px corner brackets top-left (mint) and bottom-right (dim), radius 2px
Code box with syntax colours (comment grey, keyword amber, string mint, function cyan, var rose)
Uppercase outlined tags (mint / amber / red)
Footer rule with uppercase micro-labels and 'NN / 08'
themes.motion: hcRise: translateY(18px) + fade, 0.6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), staggered 0.06s; cursor blink steps(2) 1s. Reduced motion disables both.
themes.research_fit: Fits robotics-software / systems demos in dark rooms. Gaps: glow and scanlines hurt projector legibility, no figure or maths layout, smallest labels 10px.
flags: Card labels and footer 10px, chrome and tags 11px, card text 13px, code 14px, lede 18px: all below 24px (12pt).
Glow text-shadow, scanlines and vignette reduce legibility on projectors; tell the user if the room is large.

themes.name: Pentagram Grid
themes.author: alchaincyf / huashu-design ppt-pentagram (MIT), extended to a deck by OpenDesign
themes.stance: Swiss info-architecture: white paper with black bookends, one red (#E63946) exactly where the eye must land, giant weight-900 numerals, measured grid.
themes.canvas: Fixed 1920x1080 #stage scaled by fit(); every measurement in px; 80px outer margins; 64px chrome bars.

fonts.role: the only family; no web fonts; falls back to Arial on Windows

scale: graded grey to black to red
colors: the only red; at most 4 touches per page
devices: 64px black chrome bars top and bottom: uppercase label with a red '/', red right label, 900-weight logotype + divider + footnote
Swiss grid hairlines: 1px verticals and horizontals at 5% opacity on the 80px gutters
One giant 900-weight numeral per hero page; only its decimal point, slash or unit is red
Red / black / grey bar charts: the subject is always the red bar, value printed inside
Summary strip: hairline-topped row of 32px numbers with uppercase captions
Outlined red badge, square corners; zero border-radius everywhere
White pages dominate; at most 2-3 dark pages (divider, closing)
themes.motion: Opacity-only page fade 0.45s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); nothing else moves.
themes.research_fit: Strongest for results-heavy talks: the red-bar convention maps directly to 'ours vs baselines'. Gaps: body and labels are very small for projection, Helvetica Neue isn't free to ship, no figure-image or maths layout.
flags: Body 15-18px and labels 11-13px sit on a fixed 1920 canvas, so they project at 5.5-9pt, well below the 18-24pt talk advice asks for.

Contrast: --muted #999 on white is 2.85:1 and --faint #BBB is 1.92:1 (both fail 4.5:1); small red text #E63946 on white is 4.17:1 (fails below large-text size; the seed uses red mostly on large numerals and bars).
Helvetica Neue is a licensed system font, not shipped; on Windows/Linux it falls back to Arial.

themes.name: Notebook Tabs
themes.author: Zara Zhang (frontend-slides, MIT)
themes.stance: A physical notebook: cream paper card on a dark desk, binder holes, pink margin rule, five pastel index tabs on the fore-edge marking the current section.
themes.canvas: Fixed 1920x1080 .deck-stage scaled uniformly; paper inset 56/150/56/120px; content padding 78px 110px (150px left).
devices: Paper card with layered drop shadow and faint 44px ruled grain
Ten punched binder holes down the left margin; 1px pink margin rule at 92px
Five vertical index tabs on the right edge, tucked under the paper; current section's tab is pulled out
Running head 'No. NN' + section, and a baseline 'section / NN of total', both hairline-ruled
Outlined 430px Bodoni section numeral
Colour chips that tie kickers, contents rows and bars to their section's tab colour
Hard 8px offset shadow in sky blue on the 'this work' comparison column
themes.motion: Reveal: translateY(28px) + fade, 0.7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), staggered 0.1s; bars grow with scaleY 0.9s. Reduced motion: fades only.
themes.research_fit: Built for capstone and thesis defenses; the tab index works as a live agenda. Largest body text of the five. Gaps: playful tone for a conference, no figure-image, video or maths layout, max 3 points per slide.
flags: Footer 15px and labels/tabs 17px are below 24px (12pt); body 26px (13pt) and lede 30px (15pt) pass the Slides floor but are under the 18-24pt that talk advice asks for.
Max 3 points per slide is a template rule.
